_about: The five fixed spots of verify_runtime.ps1. Each one is a saved checkpoint (save folder copy + checkpoint.json with the map, Sam's spawn position and the start camera direction), recorded once with: verify_runtime.ps1 -CaptureCheckpoint <name>. Pick spawns next to a wall (grazing-wall yaws) with Sam fully in view. pitches: the first must be 0 (reference pose); +30 brings the camera low and close to Sam. nearField: distance in game units (cm) under which the depth outline is taken; Sam stands ~250 units from the third-person camera. goggleKeys: spare keys verify_runtime binds to the game's ToggleVisionMode / ChangeVisionMode commands in inputTranslations.ini for the run.
